items.title: CONSENT CALENDAR

Approve Modification No. 1 to Job Order Contract No. JOC-104, General Engineering (A License) Construction, San Joaquin, Stanislaus, and Tuolumne Counties, Hetch Hetchy, with Peterson Excavation, Inc., to increase the contract not- to-exceed amount by $2,500,000, and increase the contract duration by three years, for a revised not-to-exceed contract amount of $7,500,000 and a total contract duration of five years, to provide additional time and capacity for facility and asset improvements. -

Approve Modification No. 1 to Job Order Contract No. JOC-102R, General Engineering (A License) Construction, San Joaquin, Stanislaus, and Tuolumne Counties, Hetch Hetchy, with Pacific Engineering & Construction, Inc., to increase the contract duration by three years, for a total contract duration of five years, with no change to the contract amount, to provide additional time for facility and asset improvements

Approve Amendment No. 3 to Contract No. PRO.0181, Westside Pump Station Construction Management Staff Augmentation Services, with MCK Americas, Inc., increasing the contract amount by $600,000, and increasing the contract duration by one year and six months, for a total not-to-exceed contract amount $3,900,000 and a total contract duration of six years, to provide continued construction management staff-augmentation services to reflect the extension in construction duration for construction Contract No. WW-645R, Westside Pump Station Reliability Improvements

Approve an increase of 76 calendar days to the duration contingency for Contract No. WW-725, Various Locations Sewer Replacement No. 14, with JDB & Sons Construction, Inc., for a revised duration limit of 617 calendar days (approximately one year and eight months), to allow for additional time to complete all contract work due to differing and unforeseen site conditions, with no change to the contract amount or amount contingency

Accept work performed by M. Squared Construction, Inc., under Contract No. WD- 2896, 12-Inch Ductile Iron Water Main Installation on Webster Street from Grove Street to Eddy Street; approve Modification No. 3 (Final) decreasing the contract amount by $21,960 and increasing the contract duration by 24 calendar days, for a total contract amount of $1,698,480, and a total contract duration of 338 consecutive calendar days (approximately ten months), to adjust the final contract amount to the value of actual contract quantities and adjust the final contract duration to renew an additional water service and perform final pavement restoration; and authorize final payment to the contractor

Award Contract No. WW-767R, Southeast Water Pollution Control Plant Booster Station Interim Improvements, to the responsible bidder that submitted the lowest responsive bid, Mountain Cascade, Inc., in the amount of $19,339,195 and with a duration of 880 consecutive calendar days (approximately two years and five months), to extend the useful life of the Booster Station by addressing structural, mechanical, electrical, and health & safety improvements
Approve an increase of $1,500,000 to the cost contingency and an increase of 360 calendar days to the duration contingency for Contract No. WW-662R
items.text: Approve an increase of $1,500,000 to the cost contingency and an increase of 360 calendar days to the duration contingency for Contract No. WW-662R, Southeast Water Pollution Control Plant Power Feed and Primary Switchgear Upgrades, with Blocka Construction, Inc., for a revised cost limit of $37,318,620 and a revised duration limit of 2,298 calendar days (approximately six years and four months), due to unforeseen site issues, design clarifications, and potential additional cost related to delays in re-design and short circuit coordination study of electrical distribution system per Pacific Gas and Electric Company requirements

items.title: Approve an increase of $8,000,000 to the cost contingency and an increase of 638 calendar days to the duration contingency for Contract No. WW-639
items.decision: approve Item 8 including the corrected resolution
items.text: Approve an increase of $8,000,000 to the cost contingency and an increase of 638 calendar days (approximately one year and nine months) to the duration contingency for Contract No. WW-639, Oceanside Water Pollution Control Digester Gas Utilization Upgrades, with Monterey Mechanical Co. for a revised cost limit of $62,293,900 and a revised duration limit of up to 3,231 calendar days (approximately nine years and three months), to upgrade site electrical service to meet Pacific Gas and Electric Company Wholesale Distribution Tariff requirements. The Director of Commission Affairs announced that an edit was made to the third whereas clause within the resolution correcting the original contract duration to 820 consecutive calendar days and stated that the corrected resolution is included for consideration by the Commission

items.title: Approve an increase of 602 calendar days to the duration contingency for Contract No. WW-645R
items.text: Approve an increase of 602 calendar days (approximately one year and eight months) to the duration contingency for Contract No. WW-645R, with Anvil Builders, Inc., for a revised duration limit of 2,264 calendar days (approximately six years and three months) to address procurement, site civil and structural work, system integration, and third-party (Pacific Gas and Electric Company) delays in providing electric service, with no change to the contract amount or amount contingency

items.title: Accept work performed by Western Water Constructors, Inc., under Contract No. WW- 685R
items.text: Accept work performed by Western Water Constructors, Inc., under Contract No. WW- 685R, North Shore Pump Station Wet Weather Improvements; approve Modification No. 19 (Final) increasing the contract duration by 249 calendar days, for a total contract duration of 1,664 consecutive calendar days (approximately four years and six months), due to delays associated with the cutover and controls testing of existing assets and newly installed assets, with no change to contract amount; and authorize final payment to the contractor
